description:
Sweep follow-up to JMAP-sc1b.53 / JMAP-sc1b.66.

Type crate test fixtures using clone-subtree pattern:
- crate-jmap-types/src/methods.rs: 4 sites (340, 456, 504, 603)
- crate-jmap-sharing-types/src/notification.rs: 2 sites (224, 264)
- crate-jmap-sharing-types/src/principal.rs: 2 sites (174, 310)
- crate-jmap-sharing-types/src/capability.rs: 2 sites (91, 106)

All are #[cfg(test)] inside the type crates. Most are roundtrip tests of the form 'let json = ...; let v = from_value(json.clone()); ...' where json is not used after. T::deserialize(&json) avoids the clone cleanly.

P4 because test-only code path; correctness unaffected. Bundling these together because the change is mechanical and they all live in *-types crates.

If a workspace-wide cargo-machete-style sweep is later done, this could roll up into it.
title: P4: 10 from_value(v.clone()) sites in type-crate cfg(test) fixtures
